source: Nevada Division of Public and Behavioral Health advisories, as listed in the Nevada Fishing Regulations

advisories.area: Carson River from Dayton to Lahontan Dam and all waters in Lahontan Valley

fish: No more than one eight-ounce meal per week

statewide: Mercury builds up in older, bigger predatory fish (walleye, wipers, white bass, bass, pike). Keep smaller fish to eat, and eat fewer meals of the big ones, especially if you are pregnant or feeding kids.
